pages.text: There once was a little red hen who lived with her friends on a farm. She was not a lazy hen. She worked harder than all of the other animals. The Little Red Hen wanted to plant some grains of wheat. She asked for help, but her friends refused.

So she planted the grains herself. In the summertime, the wonderful golden wheat was ready to be harvested. Once again, with no one to help her, the Little Red Hen did all the work. The Little Red Hen had to grind the wheat into flour.

As usual, her friends did not want to do any hard work. So the Little Red Hen ground the flour herself. The Little Red Hen used the flour to make bread dough. With no one to help her, she kneaded the dough all by herself. The Little Red Hen’s friends had completely abandoned her.

So she baked the bread all by herself. When the smell of freshly baked bread rose up into the air, the Little Red Hen’s friends appeared. They were willing to help eat the bread, but the Little Red Hen ate it all by herself. She had done all the work!
